subject: Billing cutoff alignment & accelerated settlement proposal
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@meridianlabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Meridian Labs AR <ar@meridianlabs.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Apr 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice schedule & early settlement inquiry

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're kicking off vendor setup on our side and want to align on two items before we send our first batch of invoices:

- Our AP cutover is the 1st and 16th of every month (mid-month + month-end). Can Redwood match invoice acceptance / PO visibility to that cadence?
- We typically offer vendors an early settlement option: if Redwood can accept payment within 15 days, AR would authorize a 1.5% settlement fee. Is that something your finance team could accept for this onboarding?

I'm attaching our standard AP onboarding form (Meridian_AP_Form.pdf) and can route a PO once we confirm the cadence and the early settlement terms. If helpful, AR is fine joining a quick call to run through internal PO numbering and remittance details.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Strategic Procurement
Meridian Labs
Attachments: Meridian_AP_Form.pdf (pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Meridian Labs AR <ar@meridianlabs.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice schedule & early settlement inquiry

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and thanks for the form. Quick answers and next steps below: 

1) Billing cadence: We can accept invoices aligned to the 1st and 16th cutoffs. For clean routing and PO matching please use our PO header template; I'll attach Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx so your AP team can map fields to your system.

2) Accelerated settlement: We can evaluate a 15-day accelerated settlement at ~1.5% (or equivalent ACH timing). I need to confirm with Finance for this specific account and whether the discount can be applied at the invoice level or via a netting credit.

Next steps: 
- Please complete Meridian_AP_Form.pdf and return it to ar@meridianlabs.com and me.
- I'll loop in Finance for approval and confirm whether the early settlement will be processed through our payables hub or a third-party provider.
- If you can share a sample PO number pattern, we can pre-configure PO routing to avoid mismatches at cutoff.

Tentative timeline: I'll aim to confirm Finance decision by EOD Monday. If AR is available, let's do a 30-min sync on Tuesday to finalize mapping.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Apr 2028 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice schedule & early settlement inquiry — Meridian Labs (need decision)

Ben / David — forwarding Meridian's ask below. Key points: 15-day accelerated settlement at 1.5% for onboarding, billing cutoffs on 1st/16th. They will supply completed AP form and a sample PO pattern.

Questions for Finance:
- Can we approve 1.5% fee for 15-day early settlement for a new mid-market account at launch? Any pref to handle via net credit vs per-invoice discount?
- Does the 1st/16th cutoff create any reconciliation risk for our payables hub? Meridian would like PO visibility before acceptance to avoid rejections.

Ben — can you weigh in on whether we should accept the % as-is or push for net-20 / 0.75% to reduce margin impact? David — any operational flags on PO header mapping from earlier onboarding flows?

Thanks — Naomi

Hi all — quick update from Finance / Ops after a brief review: 

- We can approve a 15-day accelerated settlement at 1.25% (counter-offer). That structure keeps our unit economics reasonable and is consistent with similar onboarding promos we run. If Meridian absolutely needs 1.5%, we can accommodate for the first two invoice cycles as a temporary onboarding concession, subject to review.
- Operationally we can map the 1st/16th cutoffs into our PO routing. Please confirm sample PO pattern (e.g., ML-2028-XXXX) and we will pre-seed the matcher. 

Next steps (action owners):
- Elena / Meridian AR: return completed Meridian_AP_Form.pdf and send a sample PO number by Tue 4/17.
- Naomi: I'll prep a short payment terms addendum (one-page) that specifies the 15-day settlement discount and whether it's applied per-invoice or as a net credit. I'll also attach the DocuSign link once ready.
- David: coordinate PO header mapping with ops and confirm there are no blocked fields.

Elena — if that works, I'll issue a DocuSign link for the one-page settlement addendum today and set the onboarding tag in HubSpot (DEAL-2028-0457).

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
